goals.title: Cloud Run migration Turn 2: migrate desk schedule, daily journal, sup...
goals.objective: Cloud Run migration Turn 2: migrate desk schedule, daily journal, supplies, and recruiting handlers behind authenticated Cloud Run APIs; preserve Apps Script fallback, add parity and idempotency safeguards, deploy, and verify through Chrome academy profile without risking operating data.

criteria.scenario: Happy path works from the real user-facing surface.
command: set -euo pipefail; page=$(curl -fsS https://sedubanpo.github.io/desk-portal/); grep -q canFallbackFromDeskFirebaseLogin_ <<<"$page"; grep -q DESK_CLOUD_API_BASE <<<"$page"; health=$(curl -fsS https://desk-portal-api-262959464514.asia-northeast3.run.app/health); grep -q '"ok":true' <<<"$health"; grep -q desk-portal-api-00002-5br <<<"$health"; cd services/desk-api; npm test

criteria.scenario: Riskiest edge or failure path is handled.
command: set -euo pipefail; cd services/desk-api; node --test --test-name-pattern="completed idempotent writes|writes without an idempotency key|me requires a Firebase bearer token"; body=$(mktemp); code=$(curl -sS -o "$body" -w "%{http_code}" -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"payload\":{}}" https://desk-portal-api-262959464514.asia-northeast3.run.app/v1/desk/getDeskScheduleBootstrap); test "$code" = 401; grep -q authentication_required "$body"; rm -f "$body"

goals.evidence: Production surface, API tests, authentication rejection, idempotency safeguards, and Chrome academy-profile fallback verified.

aggregateCompletion.evidence: Production surface, API tests, authentication rejection, idempotency safeguards, and Chrome academy-profile fallback verified.
